business_problem: Four Agency saw AI as a fundamental shift for marketing services and wanted a tool that fit its existing Microsoft workflow while helping teams handle creativity, reporting, and administration faster.
solution_summary: Four Agency treated Microsoft 365 Copilot as a core addition to the way its 350-person marketing team works rather than as a niche pilot for a few specialists. Because the agency already ran on the Microsoft stack, it rolled Copilot out universally and paired the deployment with staff training, change management, and safe-use guidance so everyone could build confidence together. Teams now use Copilot for creative brainstorming, content creation, HR and other admin-heavy processes, data analysis, and report generation under tight agency deadlines. The tool fits directly into the workflows employees already use, which helped speed adoption and reduce friction. By shortening paperwork and helping teams deliver client outputs faster, Copilot frees staff to spend more time on higher-value outreach and strategic work.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
solution_components.role: Uses organizational context to summarize meetings, draft content, and help employees complete knowledge work faster.

business_outcome: Copilot is especially useful in admin heavy processes, such as HR, data analysis, and report generation. It helps the team provide client outputs and reports faster, and it also assists with creative work such as generating ideas to kick off brainstorming sessions.
